Serco is a defense and technology services company supporting government and commercial clients. The company is seeking an entry-level Software Engineer to support its Wideband SATCOM Trend Analysis & Anomaly Resolution Subsystem in developing software, RESTful APIs, and microservices. The role also involves software testing, troubleshooting, agile collaboration, and continuous delivery support.

Responsibilities
Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle
Write well designed, testable, and efficient code
Conduct software analysis, programming, testing, debugging activities and maintenance
Develop technical designs for application development and recommend changes to improve established application processes
Architect and build RESTful APIs and microservices using Java and Spring Boot. General knowledge of Relational Databases (eg Postgres, Oracle) and SQL language. Frontend experience using frameworks like react
Participate fully in agile ceremonies (stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives) and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
Diagnose and resolve complex production issues quickly and effectively with a focus on code quality and system uptime
Support continuous delivery pipelines
